title: Identification of the given map PP∇ with iota|_M is circular w.r.t. the saturation gap

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** Step 1--2 of Proposition `prop:iso-onto-image` (Section \ref{sec:proj}).

**Gap.** The proof equates the **given** finite injective $\mathbb{P}\nabla:M\to N$ (target $N=\mathbb{P}Z/\!\!/G$, the GIT quotient of the *quasi-projective* $\mathbb{P}Z$) with $j^{-1}\circ(\iota|_M)$ by invoking uniqueness of categorical quotients. But $\iota=\operatorname{Proj}(\varphi)$ lives on the GIT quotients of the **full** projective spaces $\mathbb{P}(\mathcal V),\mathbb{P}(\mathcal W)$. The asserted compatibility presupposes the open immersion $j:N\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Proj}S$, which is exactly the unproved content of `lem:Nopen` (saturation issue). Thus Step 2's identification is **circular** with respect to that gap: it assumes precisely what must be proved.

**What must be supplied.** A genuine compatibility statement: that the good quotient of the quasi-projective $\mathbb{P}Z$ (with the restricted linearization) maps compatibly to $\operatorname{Proj}S$ and that the given $\mathbb{P}\nabla$ factors as claimed. This becomes legitimate only after the saturation/stability issue (companion issues) is resolved; until then the chain "$\mathbb{P}\nabla$ is a locally closed immersion $\Rightarrow$ closed image $\Rightarrow$ $M\cong Y$" is not justified.
